description: Forensics on a truncated download: the archive was cut mid-entry, so inspect_zip / list_zip_entries fail (no central directory). scan_zip_forward walks the local headers in stream order and, with tolerateTruncation true, returns the partial inventory plus error { code: ZIP_STREAM_TRUNCATED, ... } and stoppedAt 'error' instead of failing. NOT authoritative: trust is 'local-headers-only'.
